content: Candidate 1 (id:1) achieved Gain=656.1, I=175uA, Area=0.58nm2, Noise=0.026; violated PM (36 deg), SR (24 V/us), UGBW (25.4 MHz). Candidate 2 (id:2) with 45nm lp1/lp3 showed gain collapse (11.5) due to low ro / offset despite PM=76 deg. Plan: keep Candidate 1 as baseline, maintain L=90nm for output resistance/balance, scale mn1 width and stage currents (mn4, mn5) to improve UGBW and SR, and use Rc for PM.

Best id:1. Violations: ugbw (-0.595, 25.4MHz), phm (-0.25, 36.0deg), slewRate (-0.112, 24.0V/us). Headroom in gain (+0.533) and current (175uA < 200uA). Chosen lever: scale input pair size mn1 (4 -> 12) to raise gm1 and UGBW towards target while keeping balance.

Candidate 3 (id:3) mn1=12 increased UGBW only from 25.4MHz to 26.57MHz (predicted 45-55MHz), reward -0.9226. Lesson: UGBW is clamped by the second pole p2 = gm6 / CL (CL=10pF) and small Cc. Raising gm1 alone cannot boost UGBW; gm6 must be increased via higher I_2 (mn5) and wider mp3.

Best id:3. Diagnosed that gm1 was current-limited in weak inversion. Chosen lever: reduce cap (1.5pF -> 0.8pF) to boost gm1/Cc and SR directly, while rebalancing stage currents: mn4=7 (I_tail~70uA), mn5=9 (I_2~90uA), mp1=7, mp3=18 to maintain zero offset (2*S5/S4 = 18/7). Total current ~190uA.

Swept res [1000..4000] on id:4. Best is id:11 (res=4000) with PM=55.11 deg (up from 26.3 deg), UGBW=40.8MHz, reward=-0.4327. PM monotonically improves with Rc due to LHP zero phase lead. One more step with res~4800 is expected to reach PM > 60 deg.

Candidate 12 (id:12, res=4800) achieved PM=60.75 deg (feasible!), slewRate=36.33 V/us (feasible!), gain=675.3, I=176.8uA, area=0.64nm2, reward=-0.3709. Only single violation remaining is ugbw (42.9MHz vs 100MHz). Handing over to diagnoser.

Best id:12. Only violation is ugbw (-0.400, 42.9MHz). PM (60.75 deg) and SR (36.3 V/us) are feasible. Headroom in gain (675) and current (176.8uA). Chosen lever: reduce cap from 0.8pF to 0.4pF to scale UGBW towards 100MHz.

Swept res [5500..9500] on id:13. Best is id:18 (res=9500) with PM=62.05 deg (feasible!), UGBW=69.90MHz, SR=48.78 V/us, reward=-0.1538. PM restored above 60 deg by LHP zero phase lead. Only single spec remaining below target is UGBW (69.9MHz vs 100MHz).

Best id:18. FoM=-0.1538. Only violation is ugbw (-0.177, 69.9MHz vs 100MHz). All other constraints satisfied with margin. Chosen lever: reduce cap from 4e-13 to 3e-13 / 2e-13 to achieve UGBW >= 100MHz.

Candidate 19 (id:19, cap=2e-13) reached UGBW=81.15MHz (predicted 110-130MHz) and PM=45.6 deg. Lesson: UGBW is clamped by the second pole gm6/CL (CL=10pF). Reducing Cc cannot reach 100MHz alone; gm6 must be increased by raising I_2 (mn5) and mp3 under exact balance.

Best id:18. To break through the second-pole limit on UGBW, chosen lever is scaling gm6: mn5=12 (I_2=120uA), mp3=24, mp1=5 (ratio S_mp3/S_mp1 = 24/5 = 2*S5/S4 = 4.8) with cap=3e-13. Expected effect: doubles p2, boosts UGBW >= 100MHz, maintains PM >= 60 deg at 200uA current.

Candidate 20 (id:20) reached UGBW=99.37MHz (99.4% of 100MHz spec), gain=751.8, current=198.8uA, SR=65.6V/us, PM=51.5 deg, reward=-0.0585. Rebalancing gm6 via mp3=24, mn5=12 pushed UGBW by +30MHz. Slight increase in wn1 (2.0u->2.25u) will push UGBW safely above 100MHz.

Candidate 20 is at UGBW=99.37MHz and PM=51.5 deg. Diagnosed that large mp3 (m=24) with res=9500 creates a parasitic pole p3 = 1/(Rc*Cgs3) ~ 550MHz that subtracts ~10 deg of PM. Chosen lever: sweep res [3000..7500] on id:20 to optimize PM and push UGBW across 100MHz.

Phase 1 limit reached (25 simulations). Best design is Candidate 20 (id:20) with FoM = -0.0585, meeting gain (752), current (198.8uA), SR (65.6 V/us), noise (0.0187), and area (0.83nm2). Only minor violations remain in UGBW (99.37MHz) and PM (51.5 deg). Handing over to RL refiner anchored on id:20.

RL completed 700 simulations (100 warmup + 600 training). Best before: id:20 (FoM = -0.0585). Best after: id:625 (FoM = +0.01154). Candidate 625 has PM=62.47 deg (feasible), SR=61.06 V/us (feasible), gain=772.7, current=204.3uA, area=0.763nm2, and UGBW=97.96MHz (only 2.04MHz from target). Key differences vs expert id:20: cap=5e-13, res=7700, mn1=10/wn1=1.5u/ln1=135n, mn4=8, mn5=13, mp1=6, mp3=23. Sizer will polish UGBW across 100MHz threshold.

Candidate 625 needs only +2.04MHz UGBW to achieve full feasibility (PM=62.5 deg, SR=61.1V/us, Gain=773 already feasible). Chosen lever: sweep mn1 [10..14] on base_id=625 to boost gm1 by 10-40% and cross 100MHz without disturbing DC currents.

Candidate 730 achieved FULL FEASIBILITY (FoM = 0.7301, feasible=True, violated=[]). Specs: Gain=812.7, PM=60.45 deg, UGBW=100.1MHz, SR=62.17V/us, Noise=0.01608, Current=205.4uA, Area=0.771nm2. Every hard constraint is satisfied!

RL round 2 completed 160 simulations (30 warmup + 130 training). Reached 7 feasible designs total. Best design remains Candidate 730 with FoM = 0.7301 (feasible=True). Total simulator calls: 890. Passing to final polish.
Phase 4 Polish on best feasible id:730 (FoM=0.7301). Margin is tightest on PM (60.45 deg) and UGBW (100.1MHz). Chosen lever: sweep res [7700..8100] to optimize PM robustness and area.

Final solution: Candidate 730 is fully feasible with FoM = 0.7301. All hard constraints satisfied (Gain=812.7, PM=60.45 deg, UGBW=100.1MHz, SR=62.17V/us, Noise=0.01608).
